prompt: Create ONE Sanada Masayuki dialogue character portrait for gritty Japanese Sengoku action game. Sanada Yukimura's father, a cunning seasoned Japanese veteran strategist in his late50s/early60s: deeply lined weathered face, narrow intelligent eyes, calm intimidating confidence, long flowing dark beard streaked with gray extending to mid chest, mustache, dark graying hair tied back in a modest samurai topknot. NO HELMET, no head armor. He wears worn dark crimson/red-and-black samurai lamellar ARMOR and OVER the armor a clearly visible thick BROWN ANIMAL-FUR SLEEVELESS VEST, shaggy coarse natural dark-brown pelts, open front, substantial fur shoulders and sides. The brown fur vest is the defining design feature. Sanada six coins emblem only: six simple gold circles arranged two rows of three on a small visible chest plate; no Tokugawa three-leaf crests or other family motifs. Chest-up bust, LEFT-facing three-quarter view, complete head/topknot/beard/shoulders inside canvas with generous transparent margins. Square1254x1254 PNG, real fully TRANSPARENT background. Reference image ONLY for rendering style and chest-up framing; do NOT copy its face, white mane, purple robes, gold armor or Tokugawa crests. Painterly realistic game illustration, detailed physically credible armor/fur, strong dignified silhouette, muted earthy colors, no glowing eyes or supernatural features. No weapons across face, effects, light trails, text, labels, UI or scenery. One figure.
visualReview: Helmet-free veteran, long gray-streaked beard, shaggy brown fur sleeveless vest over crimson armor, six-coins emblem. Left-facing chest-up, full hair/beard/shoulders, alpha/margins and OCR reviewed.
